name: Plank
steps: Place elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head, hips and heels in one straight line.
mistakes: Do not allow your lower back to sag.
Do not raise your hips too high.
Stop for sharp shoulder or lower-back pain.

name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest.
Keep your feet flat and your back supported.
Press forward smoothly, then return slowly.
mistakes: Do not bounce the weight stack.
Do not lock your elbows hard.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Secure your thighs under the pad.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest and return slowly.
mistakes: Do not pull behind your neck.
